problems: The blind guess ('stick-figure skeleton, arms outstretched') matches the drawing's silhouette better than the intended kite. Nothing reads as a sail: there is no closed diamond-shaped sail outline, only open gold polylines.

The sail corners are cramped. Apex 77257 (~308,213) and right shoulder 77070 (~320,232) sit almost on top of each other, so the sail has no width. Left corner 77622 (~287,271) is the only corner that opens out.
The tassels 77660 (~285,424) and 77516 (~293,432) nearly overlap, so the tail reads as a single blob, not two tassels.

The left ribbon (80179 at ~129,341, 80883 at ~84,321) and the right streamer (75761 at ~398,323, 74975 at ~447,326) run as long horizontal arms. Together with the tail hanging down, they look like outstretched arms and legs.
Labels collide: 'bend in the right-hand streamer' overlaps 'far tip of the right-hand st...', and the 'left corner' and 'top apex' labels are cut through by strokes.
The blue strokes run almost parallel to the gold ones as a near-duplicate echo. This reads as a doubled line, not a true silhouette fill or outline of the kite.
output.advice: Redraw so the figure reads as a bridled kite, not a figure. (1) Make the sail a closed quadrilateral: apex 77257 at ~(308,213), right shoulder 77070 pushed out to ~(365,290), left corner 77622 at ~(287,271), and a bottom vertex near ~(300,320). Fill or outline the sail as one shape. (2) Run the spar as a straight line from apex 77257 down through the sail to its foot (~(300,320)). (3) Keep the pennant 76276 at ~(367,148) as a thin line rising from the apex. (4) Bridle and ribbons: from left corner 77622 run the left ribbon through 80179 (~129,341) and end at 80883 (~84,321) as a wavy streamer. (5) Right streamer: from shoulder 77070 go through bend 75761 and end at 74975 with a slight S-curve, not a straight arm. (6) Tail: from the sail foot draw a single tail line down, then split at the bottom into two tassels, 77660 at ~(280,430) and 77516 at ~(300,440), at least 20px apart.
